basis: PCA32 fit to prompt needle-end states only
curve: ten discovery needle-end count centroids, centered by their mean

formula_models.category_baseline: discovery mean separately for each token category
formula_models.endpoint_gated_curve: baseline + gamma(occurrence) only at needle endpoints
formula_models.needle_span_gated_curve: baseline + gamma(occurrence) at every needle-span token
formula_models.ungated_prefix_curve: baseline + gamma(completed-prefix-count) at all token categories
